About Our Client  Our client is an AI-led operating system for the drayage industry. They power trucking companies that move containers in and out of the ports, a mission-critical often overlooked corner of the supply chain.  Drayage is a fragmented, relationship-heavy market with over 80% of carriers running fewer than 20 trucks, and they don't respond to mass-blast outbound. Winning here requires a GTM motion that's smarter, more researched, and more personalized than the rest of freight tech. That's where this role comes in. The Role  We're hiring our first dedicated GTM Engineer  to sit at the intersection of sales, marketing, and product. You'll build the systems, workflows, and AI-powered tooling that let a focused revenue team generate an enterprise-grade pipeline without enterprise-grade headcount. If you've ever looked at a sales motion and thought \"this could be 10x more efficient with the right stack, the right data, and a few well-placed LLM calls\" this is the role for you. You'll have the rare combination of a real ICP (drayage carriers and brokers), a rich domain (FMCSA data, port operations, chassis pools, intermodal flows), and autonomy to build. What You'll Own Outbound & Account Intelligence  Build and maintain enrichment pipelines that combine FMCSA SAFER data, port activity signals, fleet composition, chassis ownership, terminal proximity, and TMS incumbency to score and prioritize drayage carriers and brokers Develop LLM-powered personalization workflows in Clay, Apollo, or similar so every outbound touch references the prospect's actual operating reality, not a generic \"growing your trucking business\" pitch Stand up intent-data and remarketing reconciliation flows across our tech stack  Sales Enablement & Pre-Call Intelligence  Productize pre-call intel briefs into automated, repeatable artifacts AEs can pull on demand Build and maintain competitive battlecards and displacement playbooks for our most common takeouts (CompCare/Compcare, Profit Tools, Trinium, McLeod, Tailwind, in-house systems)  Call Intelligence & Revenue Analytics  Build pipelines from Gong (or successor) into LLM workflows that produce daily/weekly sales reports, surface objection patterns, flag at-risk deals, and feed competitive intel back to product and marketing Partner with RevOps to build attribution, conversion, and velocity dashboards that actually inform decisions not just decorate Monday meetings  Field & Event Activation  Build the systems behind PortFest, Drive, TPM and regional drayage association events: pre-event prospect lists, post-event nurture flows, on-site demo capture, attribution back to pipeline Help marketing run experiments on messaging, positioning, and channel mix and instrument them properly so we learn from what works  Internal AI Tooling  Stand up and govern internal AI workflows the GTM team uses daily: prompt libraries, custom Claude/GPT projects, RAG over our content library, MCP integrations with our CRM and call platforms Be the person who decides when a workflow should be a Clay table vs. a Python script vs. a real product request to engineering  What We're Looking For Required  3+ years in a GTM Engineering, RevOps, Sales Engineering, or Growth Engineering role and a bonus if any of that was at a vertical B2B SaaS company Working proficiency in Python and SQL; comfortable in JavaScript when needed Deep, opinionated fluency with the modern GTM stack: Clay, Apollo (or similar), Gong, Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) prompt design, tool use, evals, cost management A track record of shipping systems that demonstrably moved a revenue metric: pipeline created, meetings booked, win rate, cycle time  Strongly Preferred  Domain knowledge in freight, logistics, supply chain, or trucking or proven ability to ramp on a complex vertical fast Familiarity with FMCSA data sources (SAFER, L&I, MCS-150), or analogous public/regulatory datasets in another vertical Experience with MCP, agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.), or production AI Orchestration  You'll thrive here if you  Get genuinely curious about the operational details of how a drayage carrier makes money: chassis splits, per diem, demurrage, accessorials, the difference between asset-based and brokerage authority Default to building rather than briefing; You'd rather ship a v1 in a week than write a 20-page requirements doc Treat AEs and CSMs as your customers; their adoption of what you build is the measure of whether it worked- Are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows how a particular system actually works, and write things down so that changes  What Success Looks Like By 90 days:  Pre-call intel briefs and account enrichment are running on automation for the AE team; outbound personalization quality is measurably higher By 6 months:  Pipeline created per SDR/AE has meaningfully increased through better targeting and tooling By 12 months:  PortPro's GTM stack is a competitive advantage and visiting peers from other freight tech companies leave wanting what we have

title: Promo Team Lead - Brazil
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Promo Team Lead - Brazil em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Pocket FM  Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview  We are looking for a creative and execution-focused Promo Team Lead  to lead the end-to-end creation of promotional ads, trailers, and performance creatives for Pocket FM audio series in the Brazilian market. As a Promo Team Lead, you will manage a team of promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and dubbing partners to create high-quality promotional ads for Pocket FM audio series. The role requires strong understanding of promo creation, ad storytelling, localization, dubbing workflows, quality control, team management, and creative optimization. You will oversee fresh promo creation, adaptation of ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese, production quality, timely delivery, and reworks for ads that are not meeting performance benchmarks. Key Responsibilities  1. Team Leadership & Creative Direction  Lead and guide promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and external dubbing partners. Provide creative direction across writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video editing, and final delivery. Ensure the team is well-utilized, motivated, and aligned with business and creative goals. Build a high-ownership culture focused on quality, speed, and performance.  2. Promo Creation & Localization  Oversee the creation of fresh promo ads, trailers, and long-form promotional scripts for audio series. Adapt successful ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese. Ensure all promos are culturally relevant, emotionally engaging, and suitable for Brazilian audiences. Guide the team on hooks, story setup, emotional beats, cliffhangers, and audience entry points.  3. Production & Quality Control  Own the end-to-end promo production process from brief to final asset delivery. Quality check every stage, including writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video creation, and final output. Review scripts, VO/dubbing output, audio edits, video cuts, captions, and final creatives. Ensure every asset meets Pocket FM’s creative, language, production, and performance standards.  4. Dubbing Agency Management  Identify, evaluate, and onboard dubbing agencies for Brazilian Portuguese production. Coordinate with agencies for script handover, voice casting, recording, revisions, and delivery. Review dubbing output for pronunciation, emotion, pacing, tone, and character fit. Track agency timelines, pending deliverables, feedback loops, and final submissions.  5. Performance Reworks & Optimization  Review ads that are not meeting benchmark metrics and identify key creative issues. Create detailed and actionable rework hypotheses to improve ad performance. Suggest improvements such as stronger hooks, sharper conflicts, better pacing, improved localization, or revised visuals. Guide the team in creating alternate openings, new versions, and stronger creative angles. Apply campaign learnings to improve future promo concepts and execution.  6. Process, Tracking & Reporting  Maintain show-level trackers for all ads being written, adapted, dubbed, edited, reviewed, and delivered. Track ownership, status, timelines, delays, feedback, and final delivery for each asset. Share weekly progress reports with the India team and relevant stakeholders. Create SOPs, checklists, and workflows to avoid leakages across the production process.  7. AI Tool Adoption  Use GenAI tools for ad writing, ideation, VO production, image creation, video creation, and workflow improvement. Guide the team in using AI tools to improve speed, quality, and efficiency. Continuously explore new AI tools and workflows for promo production. Ensure AI-assisted outputs are reviewed for storytelling quality, cultural accuracy, and production readiness.  8. Market & Audience Understanding  Apply strong understanding of Brazilian consumer behavior, content consumption habits, and market trends. Ensure promos feel native, relevant, and compelling for Brazilian audiences. Stay updated on digital ads, audio entertainment, trailer formats, and performance creative trends.  Qualifications  Degree in Filmmaking, Marketing, Advertising, Media, Communications, or a related field. 8+ years of experience in ad creation, promo creation, trailer development, marketing creatives, ad copywriting, or performance creative production. Strong understanding of marketing, ad storytelling, promo creation, and audience engagement. Experience leading creative or production teams, including writers, editors, sound engineers, or external vendors. Excellent command of English and Brazilian Portuguese. Strong understanding of Brazilian consumer behavior, content consumption patterns, and cultural nuances. Experience working with dubbing agencies, VO artists, production teams, or post-production vendors. Skilled in GenAI tools for writing, VO production, image creation, video creation, and creative workflow improvement. Ability to create SOPs, trackers, review systems, and scalable creative processes. Strong analytical ability to review ad performance and convert insights into actionable creative reworks. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills. Strategic thinker with strong ownership and business growth orientation. Understanding of performance marketing on Meta and UAC is a plus.  Ideal Candidate  The ideal candidate is a creative leader who understands storytelling, promo production, and performance-driven advertising. They should be able to lead a multi-functional team, manage dubbing partners, maintain strong quality control, and deliver high-quality promo assets at scale. They should have strong knowledge of Brazilian audiences, excellent creative judgment, hands-on production understanding, and the ability to turn performance feedback into clear creative action. Language requirements  Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English  This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ 7,000 - $10,000 BRL.

This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.  Requirements:  Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)  Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities. Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours. Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.  Preferred Qualifications:  Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area. Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.  Perks of Freelancing With Turing:  Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.  Offer Details:  Engagement type :  Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave) Commitments Required :  Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles  Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Dual-Entity Bookkeeping & Reconciliations:  Maintain accurate, up-to-date ledgers for both the US LLC and the Brazilian entity using cloud accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks Online and local Brazilian platforms like Conta Azul / Agilize). Perform routine bank, credit card, and multi-currency payment gateway reconciliations. Track intercompany transactions  (capital injections, service fees, or expense allocations between the US entity and the Brazil office).  2. Global Billing & Accounts Receivable (AR):  Generate and dispatch accurate monthly invoices to international agency clients and programmatic partners. Manage accounts receivable for local Brazilian clients, issuing standard local invoices (Nota Fiscal de Serviço - NFS-e) where applicable. Proactively monitor outstanding balances and handle professional collections via email/phone in both English and Portuguese.  3. Accounts Payable (AP) & Local Disbursements:  Process payments for US and international tech vendors, platforms, and contractors. Manage local accounts payable in Brazil, including office expenses (São Paulo), local supplier invoices, and employee expense reports. Coordinate with our local Brazilian HR/payroll agency to ensure the local sales team is paid accurately and on time according to local labor laws (CLT/PJ structure).  4. Data Integrity & Reporting:  Properly categorize all transactions according to US tax guidelines for the LLC, and Brazilian accounting standards (BR GAAP/RFB requirements) for the local entity. Compile monthly Profit & Loss and Balance Sheets for both entities, providing a consolidated view of cash flow to ownership.  Required Qualifications & Skills: Cross-Border Experience (Mandatory):  3+ years of direct experience handling finances for a company that operates across both the US and Brazil. You must understand how US business accounting works and be familiar with standard Brazilian corporate financial practices. Language Fluency:  Flawless written and spoken English  (for US vendors/clients) and Portuguese  (for local operations, banks, and agencies). Technical Proficiency:  Deep experience with global cloud accounting tools (QuickBooks, Xero) and strong advanced skills in Excel/Google Sheets. Localization Knowledge:  Familiarity with Brazilian financial concepts like Notas Fiscais, basic withholding taxes, and foreign exchange (FX) remittance processes between US and Brazilian banks.  What We Offer: 100% remote working environment with flexibility. Direct involvement in an exciting, multi-market international expansion. Competitive compensation.

title: Client Services Assistant
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Client Services Assistant em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Client Services Assistant Remote, Latin America Velocity Work helps law firm owners build firms that are profitable, organized, accountable, and not dependent on the owner holding everything together. We’re hiring a Client Services Assistant  to become a true backbone for our team. This is not a “wait for instructions” role. It’s for someone who sees loose ends, tracks the moving pieces, asks smart questions, and makes the system better without needing someone to hover. You’ll support current clients, client data, retreat prep, onboarding, internal systems, pipeline tracking, and podcast scheduling. The work is detailed, important, and very real. If you like being the person who knows where things stand, what’s missing, and what needs to happen next, this may be a great fit. What You’ll Own ----------- Client Services Operations  This is the center of the role. You’ll help keep current client work moving cleanly: data workflows, dashboards, retreat materials, onboarding, HubSpot notes, scheduling details, internal reports, recordings, client folders, and recurring team systems. You’ll also help catch what’s slipping before it becomes a problem: missing data, unclear ownership, stalled tasks, unlogged client context, messy files, late follow-ups, or anything that makes Client Services feel less prepared. The goal is simple: current clients feel cared for, Client Services feels supported, and the team trusts that the operational details are handled. Pipeline + Relationship Tracking You’ll help us track important non-client relationships: incoming leads, meetings, deals, contracts, key dates, next steps, and handoffs. You won’t be the salesperson or the primary external email owner. You’ll keep the system accurate so the right person can follow through well and Client Services can provide a high-touch experience before someone becomes a client. Podcast Scheduling + Production Coordination You’ll help keep our podcast schedule realistic and ahead of the calendar. That means protecting planning time, suggesting recording days that match the production schedule, tracking key dates, and flagging when we need to record multiple episodes ahead because the business calendar is getting full. You won’t own content, writing, editing, or creative direction. This is schedule, process, and timeline management. This Role Is a Fit If You: • Notice gaps and communicate them early • Take ownership without needing to be chased • Track details carefully and follow through completely • Ask smart questions, then remember the answer • Can support a busy team without adding noise • Stay calm when priorities shift • Take pride in being reliable, thorough, and useful This Role Is Not a Fit If You: • Need detailed instructions for every task • Wait to be told what to do next • See problems but don’t speak up • Think “done” means “mostly handled” • Struggle when a process is not perfectly documented Requirements • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills • Clear written and verbal English • High ownership and follow-through • Strong attention to detail • Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities • Experience with calendars, spreadsheets, CRMs, project management tools, and modern SaaS systems • Fast, stable internet connection • Professional presence on video Tools may include ClickUp, HubSpot, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Loom, Fireflies, reporting dashboards, spreadsheets, and podcast scheduling tools. Work Setup Remote, Latin America preferred Contractor, 40 hours/week with meaningful overlap with U.S. business hours Compensation: $1000/mo USD (you will invoce your hours) How to Apply We care about experience, but we care more about ownership, judgment, communication, and follow-through. You’ll submit: • Your resume  • A short video introducing yourself  and telling us why this role speaks to you • Anything else that helps us understand how you think and work We will follow up with a shortlist of prospects and request a Sample Project submission that will demonstrate aspects of the work you'll be doing, and we will compensate you for the time that takes. We’re looking for someone who wants to become a real operational partner to the team, not just complete assigned tasks. If you’re the kind of person who sees the gap, owns the follow-through, and makes the whole team feel more organized, we want to meet you.

Job Description Make the world your home. It's an extraordinary time to join Etihad. In 2025 alone we've carried over 10 million guests, announced 30+ new destinations, and recorded the strongest half-year profit in our history. With more than 20 new aircraft arriving this year and a clear path to double our fleet by 2030, we're investing heavily in the future and redefining what global aviation looks like.Just as we push boundaries for our guests through innovation, sustainability, and world-class service, we're equally committed to providing our pilots with exceptional careers. Etihad, ranked the world's safest airline, offers a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle for you and your family, complemented by tax-free salaries, concessionary travel, comprehensive benefits, and endless opportunities for progression inside and beyond the cockpit.What we offer Etihad provides a competitive, tax-free package designed to reward performance and support your lifestyle in Abu Dhabi. Your annual package includes basic salary, flying pay, housing allowance, and layover and meal allowances, with the potential to earn up to AED 674,029 (USD 181,589)  per year based on 75 flying hours per month. Your salary includes performance-based annual increments, complemented by a comprehensive range of benefits:Education allowance of up to AED 40,000 for primary and AED 55,000 for secondary per child, for up to three children Income protection scheme 42 days of annual leave Industry-leading staff travel benefits and access to Etihad's exclusive discounts End-of-service benefits Accidental and life insurance coverage Etihad supports candidates relocating to Abu Dhabi through initiatives such as a shipping container allowance, settling-in support, and family travel benefits from any location in the world   The Role As a Captain with Etihad, you hold ultimate authority for the safe, secure, and efficient operation of every flight. You are entrusted with technical command of the aircraft, leadership of the crew, and the responsibility to uphold Etihad's highest standards of professionalism.Ensure the safety and security of crew, passengers, cargo, and aircraft at all times Exercise full command of the aircraft from taxi-out to final engine shutdown Lead the flight and cabin crew, demonstrating strong decision-making and effective crew resource management Operate with efficiency and environmental responsibility, in line with company fuel and sustainability policies Deliver consistent On Time Performance to meet Etihad's commitment to reliability and guest satisfaction  What you'll bring To be considered for the role of Captain A320, you must meet the criteria below:A minimum of 5500 hours total flying time. A minimum of 2500 PIC hours on multi crew, glass cockpit (1)  A minimum of 1500 PIC hours on one of the A320 Family Flown A320 family within the last 12 months Type rating on A320 should be valid for a minimum of 2 months at the time of joining Unrestricted and current ICAO ATPL Current on A320 Unrestricted and current Class 1 medical Have not attained the age of 59 years on the day of joining Current TRE/TRI is an advantage English Language Fluency (written and verbal) Level 4 or higher In case of hours accumulated on flights with inflight relief, 75% of the total hours shall be counted towards the required minimum  (1) Glass Cockpit: aircraft with a FMS coupled to APFDSAdditional Information Etihad Airways is more than the UAE's national airline - we're shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, our pilots fly one of the world's most modern and efficient fleets, operating across six continents and connecting people and cultures every day. As we advance our \"Journey 2030\" ambition to double our fleet and expand our global network, we're creating unparalleled opportunities for pilots to grow, lead and fly at the highest level. Join us and take your career to new horizons with an airline built for the future.To learn more visit  Fraud Alert Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

title: CONSULTORA COMERCIAL | CLÍNICA DE HARMONIZAÇÃO FACIAL
description:
Empresa está contratando CONSULTORA COMERCIAL | CLÍNICA DE HARMONIZAÇÃO FACIAL em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

WANTED: Consultora comercial que sabe que lead quente não espera. E que não vai deixar nenhum escapar. Cara leitora, Se você está rolando o LinkedIn há dias vendo as mesmas vagas de sempre... \"Buscamos profissional proativo com boa comunicação\" \"Requisitos: Excel avançado e experiência na área\" \"Oferecemos: salário compatível com o mercado\" ..e sente que nenhuma dessas vagas te dá vontade de levantar da cadeira e se candidatar... Para. Essa aqui é diferente. Sabe aquela sensação de fazer uma venda e pensar \"eu SABIA que ia fechar\"? É isso que você vai sentir aqui. Todo dia. Porque os leads já chegam interessados. Eles viram os resultados no Instagram. Já querem fazer o procedimento. Já estão imaginando como vão ficar. Já pesquisaram sobre harmonização. O trabalho pesado de gerar desejo? O Instagram já fez. Só falta uma coisa: alguém que conduza a conversa até o agendamento. Esse alguém é você. Você não vai precisar convencer ninguém de que harmonização funciona - os antes e depois fazem isso. Você não vai precisar criar desejo do zero - as fotos e vídeos criam. Você não vai precisar explicar por que vale a pena - as pacientes satisfeitas mostram. O que você vai precisar fazer é simples e poderoso: responder rápido, entender o momento da cliente, tirar as dúvidas certas, e não deixar ela escapar enquanto \"pensa\". A clínica entrega o resultado. O Instagram entrega o lead. Você entrega a consulta paga. É uma máquina. E você é a peça que faz ela funcionar. Sem você, lead vira só número no direct. Com você, lead vira paciente na agenda, faturamento no caixa, transformação na vida de uma mulher. SOBRE A CLÍNICA Somos uma clínica de harmonização facial que transforma a autoestima de mulheres todos os dias. Nosso Instagram gera interesse. Nossos procedimentos geram resultado. Nossas pacientes geram indicações. A demanda existe. O desejo existe. A confiança existe. O que falta é você conectando tudo isso em consultas pagas. VOCÊ É... O tipo de pessoa que vê uma notificação no direct e já sente a adrenalina de uma possível conversão. Que entende que velocidade é conversão - e age de acordo. Que não manda preço e espera. Manda preço e já prepara o próximo passo. Que trata \"vou pensar\" como o início da venda, não como o fim. Que sente satisfação real quando transforma uma conversa difícil em agendamento confirmado. É quase como se uma closer, uma estrategista e uma organizadora obsessiva tivessem uma filha. Você tem fome de resultado. E a estrutura pra sustentar isso. SUA MISSÃO Transformar seguidores em leads. Transformar leads em consultas pagas. Transformar consultas em pacientes recorrentes. Seu trabalho é não deixar ninguém escapar do funil. ..mas antes que você fique toda empolgada, vou te interromper aqui... Porque essa função não é fácil. Ok? Exige velocidade. Exige organização. Exige resiliência. E exige uma capacidade rara de manter o ritmo intenso dia após dia. A carga é pesada. O ritmo é acelerado. E a gente só quer quem aguenta o tranco. NA PRÁTICA, VOCÊ VAI: ● Monitorar o Instagram como um radar: Comentários, DMs, reações, menções. Onde tem interação, tem oportunidade. Você não espera aparecer - você vai buscar. ● Abordar rápido e trazer pro WhatsApp: A rede social é vitrine. O WhatsApp é onde você controla a conversa. Você faz essa ponte em minutos, não em horas. ● Qualificar a necessidade: Entender o que ela quer, qual o momento dela, quais as dúvidas reais. Não é só \"passar informação\" - é descobrir como ajudar ela a decidir. ● Conduzir com estratégia até a consulta PAGA: Você não agenda. Você FECHA. O ciclo só termina quando tem pagamento. ● Confirmar as consultas agendadas: Ligação, mensagem, lembrete. O que for preciso pra garantir que ela apareça. No-show é zero no caixa. ● Follow-up como rotina sagrada: 	○ Lead que perguntou e sumiu? Volta nele. 	○ Lead que disse \"tá caro\"? Entende a objeção real. 	○ Lead que disse \"vou pensar\"? Mantém o relacionamento até ela decidir. 	○ Paciente que cancelou? Reagenda. 	○ Paciente que fez há 6 meses? Hora da manutenção. ● Trabalhar a base de pacientes existentes: Quem já fez uma vez, volta. Quem gostou, indica. Sua função é ativar isso. Todo dia. ● Manter o CRM organizado em tempo real: Status atualizado, próximo passo definido, histórico completo. Você precisa saber exatamente onde cada lead está no funil. SEUS INDICADORES DE SUCESSO O QUE MUDA NO SEU DIA A DIA Urgência é regra. Seguidor que comentou AGORA precisa ser atendido AGORA. Não daqui a pouco. Não quando der. AGORA. Lead quente esfria em minutos. A concorrente responde em segundos. Velocidade é conversão. O objetivo é consulta PAGA. Vamos deixar claro: agendar não é o objetivo. Faturar é. Consulta marcada que não acontece é zero no caixa. Consulta marcada que não paga é prejuízo de tempo. O ciclo só fecha quando a consulta é paga e realizada. Base de pacientes é ouro. Sabe aquela planilha de pacientes antigos que ninguém mexe? Isso é dinheiro parado. Cada nome ali é uma mulher que já confiou na clínica, já viu resultado, já tem relacionamento. Reativar a base é mais fácil que conquistar lead novo. E você vai fazer isso todo dia. Follow-up é onde o dinheiro está. A maioria das secretárias manda preço e espera. Você não. Você entende que \"vou pensar\" não é não - é \"me convença\". Você sabe que quem sumiu depois do orçamento só precisa do lembrete certo no momento certo. Seu follow-up é o que separa agenda vazia de agenda lotada. NÃO É PRA VOCÊ SE: ● Acha follow-up \"chato\" ou \"insistente demais\" ● Manda preço e espera a cliente decidir sozinha ● Tem vergonha de puxar a conversa pra venda ● Acha que responder \"quando der\" é aceitável ● Desaparece no horário de almoço quando os leads estão pipocando ● Vê atendimento como tarefa, não como oportunidade de fechar ● Precisa que alguém fique cobrando pra você fazer follow-up É PRA VOCÊ SE: ● Entende que cada lead ignorado é dinheiro perdido ● Sente satisfação real quando converte uma conversa difícil ● Faz follow-up naturalmente - não precisa de lembrete ● Age como se cada lead fosse dinheiro do seu bolso ● Tem organização: não deixa nada cair no esquecimento ● Gosta de ritmo intenso e resultado visível ● Entende que vender bem é atender bem A CANDIDATA DOS SONHOS TEM: Velocidade: Você não deixa lead esfriar. Chegou, você responde. Ponto. Fome de resultado: Você quer converter. Quer bater meta. Quer ver o número subir. Resiliência: \"Vou pensar\" não te desanima. Te dá mais vontade de fazer o follow-up certo. Organização obsessiva: CRM atualizado, follow-ups no dia certo, zero lead esquecido. Sem precisar de cobrança. Ownership: Você trata cada lead como se fosse dinheiro do seu bolso. Porque, com comissão, é. Ritmo: Você aguenta carga intensa. E gosta disso. A MELHOR PARTE ● Remuneração competitiva: Fixo + comissão por resultado. Quanto mais você converte, mais você ganha. ● Crescimento direto: Seu salário cresce junto com sua performance. Sem teto. ● Ambiente meritocrático: Aqui vale quem gera número, não aparência de trabalho. ● Autonomia total: Liberdade pra conduzir suas conversas e criar suas estratégias.  ● Feedback claro: Você sabe exatamente se está performando ou não. Sem subjetividade. ● Treinamento: Você não vai ser jogada no fogo. Vai aprender o método que funciona. ● Impacto real: Cada consulta que você agenda muda a autoestima de uma mulher. Se você leu até aqui e pensou \"parece muito trabalho\"... não é pra você. E tá tudo bem. Se pensou \"finalmente uma vaga que paga por resultado de verdade\"... você é exatamente quem procuramos. Nos movemos em ritmo acelerado. Apenas candidatas que se destacarem serão contatadas. Se você não receber contato em 5 dias úteis, infelizmente não foi dessa vez. Palavras-chave: Secretária comercial, vaga secretária, vaga comercial, atendimento WhatsApp, atendimento Instagram, agendamento de consultas, clínica de estética, harmonização facial, vaga presencial, vaga CLT, vaga PJ, vendas, conversão de leads, follow-up, CRM, recepcionista comercial, atendente comercial, pré-vendas, SDR, closer, inside sales, vaga estética, clínica estética, consultora comercial, assistente comercial, captação de clientes, relacionamento com cliente.

description:

About Us   At Simplify CCS, we specialize in innovative contract compliance audits that deliver real value to our clients. Our work supports companies in safeguarding their strategic relationships with vendors, customers, and partners. Since 2014, we've combined expertise in audits, data analytics, and risk management to provide world-class Strategic Contract Risk Management Solutions.  Headquartered in USA, with a presence in LATAM and EMEA, Simplify serves a global clientele, growing exponentially for over 10 years because our clients understand and appreciate our approach to compliance testing through data analysis, delivered by our team of well trained and motivated subject matter experts. We are a growing international company, and we’re excited to expand our presence in Latin America—starting with you.  Our purpose: Detect the Unseen. Defend Fairness. Deliver Trust.    Your Role & Responsibilities   You’ll play a key role in owning and executing audit engagements, ensuring compliance with internal controls and external standards, and contributing directly to client-facing work. This is a senior individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities although with responsibility for mentoring, guiding, and reviewing the work of junior auditors  We are hiring for one experienced audit professional with approximately 5–6+ years of relevant audit experience who is comfortable working independently in a small, fast-moving environment.  Your main areas of impact:  Lead Licensing Audit Engagements: Take ownership of reviewing and analyzing licensing agreements, contracts, and large datasets to assess compliance and identify potential financial recovery opportunities.  Advanced Data Analysis & Testing: Design and execute audit test plans, independently analyze client data, identify anomalies, and quantify discrepancies with minimal oversight.  Client-Facing Reporting & Insights: Draft clear, well-structured audit reports that communicate key findings, root causes, and practical recommendations to improve client governance and contract compliance.  Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders and global team members, proactively sharing progress, risks, and insights to ensure audits are delivered on time and to a high standard.  Process Improvement & Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to improving audit methodologies, templates, and internal processes. Support internal initiatives such as training, documentation, and continuous improvement efforts.   ✅ What You Bring   You hold a degree in Accounting, or Finance and are eager to apply your knowledge in real-world audit scenarios; professional certifications (CPA, CIA, CISA, ACCA) are a plus  5–6+ years of experience in Contract Compliance auditing and/or Forensic Accounting within professional services; experience in the licensing industry is plus. Expert in Excel and familiar with data tools such as Power BI and similar.  English Level Advanced (C1/C2 Required).  Detail-oriented and analytical, skilled to identify risks, patterns and inconsistencies within contracts and large datasets.  Proactive Team player, demonstrating flexibility, resilience, and the ability to adapt to shifting priorities and working hours.  Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex audit findings and present insights to stakeholders with confidence and impact.  Ability to mentor and develop junior team members, providing guidance, feedback, and ongoing support.     What We Offer (LATAM - Remote)   Fully Remote Setup  Flexible Hours: Adapt your work schedule to fit your rhythm—coordinate global projects without overtime overload (mostly following EST time zone).   Paid learning: Access to language courses, online platforms, professional certifications all tailored to your personal and career goals.  Competitive USD compensation  Team Culture: Join a diverse, supportive team that values open communication, transparency, and collaboration.  Global Exposure: Gain hands-on experience with international clients across LATAM, EMEA, and North America.  Generous Paid Time Off: Enjoy 26 days of paid vacation each year to rest, recharge, and come back inspired.  Fully Equipped for Success: We’ll provide all the equipment you need — from laptops to accessories — so you can do your best work from anywhere.  Comprehensive Healthcare: Your well-being matters. We offer healthcare coverage to ensure you’re supported both personally and professionally.   We value collaboration, integrity, accountability, and a strong client-first mindset, while always finding ways to get great work done.  ⏰ Recruitment Process   Application: Submit your application via LinkedIn.  Initial Screening: Our team will review your profile to assess fit and experience.  Phone Interview: A short introductory call to understand your motivation and answer initial questions.  Technical Assessment: You'll complete a practical task or case study.  Final Interview: Meet with senior team members for a deeper conversation about the role and your potential fit.  Offer: If it's a match, you'll receive a formal offer to join our team!

Wir sind kein 08/15-Arbeitgeber, wir bauen ein Team, das remote arbeitet, aber trotzdem zusammen ist.  Und wir haben entschieden, dass \"zusammen\" auch bedeutet: einmal im Jahr gemeinsam an einem der schönsten Orte Europas. Dieses Jahr? Mallorca. Nächstes Jahr? Portugal. Immer anders. Immer unvergesslich. Deine Rolle  Du bist der erste Kontakt zu potenziellen Kunden. Über LinkedIn und Social Media baust du echte Gespräche auf, qualifizierst Interessenten und buchst Ersttermine für unser Closing-Team. Kein Cold Calling. Reines Chat-Outreach, mit Skripten und Prozessen, die funktionieren. Du musst nichts erfinden. Du kriegst alles an die Hand, was du brauchst, und wirst von Anfang an eng begleitet. Was du mitbringst  Deutsch auf höchstem Niveau, schriftlich wie mündlich (C2 oder vergleichbar), da unser gesamter Markt DACH ist und jede Nachricht perfekt klingen muss Du bist auf LinkedIn und Social Media zuhause und weißt, wie man dort echte Gespräche führt Verlässlichkeit und Eigenverantwortung Sales-Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Einstellungskriterium  Was du bekommst  Hier verdienst du solide, von Tag eins. Kein \"lass uns erstmal schauen\", kein Vertrösten. Du kennst dein Fixgehalt, bevor du auch nur eine Nachricht schreibst, und es liegt deutlich über dem Marktdurchschnitt. Dazu kommt ein Bonus für jeden gebuchten Termin. Dein Einsatz bestimmt direkt, was am Monatsende auf dem Konto landet. Und weil wir keine Stunden zählen, sondern Ergebnisse: Wer liefert, hat bei uns maximale Freiheit. Kein Micro-Management, keine Kontrolle, keine Rechtfertigungen. Du bist erwachsen, wir behandeln dich so. Außerdem:  100 % remote, du arbeitest wo und wann du willst Jährliches Team-Coworking auf Mallorca und Portugal, abwechselnd, alle Kosten übernommen Alle Tools, Skripte und Prozesse werden dir gestellt, du startest nicht bei null Schnelles Onboarding, enge Begleitung, kein Micro-Management Ein ambitioniertes Team, das sich gegenseitig weiterbringt Klare Entwicklungsperspektive, wer hier gut ist, wächst mit uns  Wie du dich bewirbst  Kein Lebenslauf, keine lange Bewerbung. Schick uns einfach eine kurze Nachricht direkt hier über LinkedIn und erzähl uns in zwei, drei Sätzen, wer du bist und warum dich diese Stelle reizt. Wir melden uns schnell.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Data Analyst em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position Summary The Data Analyst supports the company’s data and analytics initiatives by designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards, reports, and data solutions that provide actionable insights to leadership and stakeholders. This role is responsible for transforming complex data into clear, meaningful visualizations and analysis to support data-driven decision-making. The Data Analyst partners with technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, accessibility, and usability. This position contributes to advanced analytics, forecasting, and continuous improvement of reporting capabilities. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI. Build and maintain data models, custom measures, and calculations using DAX and Power Query. Analyze and validate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, consistency, and usability. Write, optimize, and maintain SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and reporting. Present insights, trends, and findings clearly to executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders. Develop predictive models and apply forecasting and statistical techniques to support business planning. Leverage Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric to support advanced analytics solutions. Partner with stakeholders to define reporting requirements and deliver analytics solutions aligned with business needs. Educate and support teams on data concepts, reporting tools, and analytics best practices. Operate effectively in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment while managing multiple priorities. Additional duties and responsibilities assigned due to business needs.  Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Strong proficiency in Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and data modeling. Strong SQL skills with the ability to extract, transform, and analyze data efficiently. Experience with Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric. Ability to present complex data clearly and effectively to non-technical audiences. Knowledge of predictive analytics, forecasting, machine learning, and statistical analysis techniques. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Passion for data visualization, continuous learning, and process improvement. Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders. Strong organizational, time-management, and prioritization skills.  Education, Training, and Experience High school diploma required; college degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field preferred. 3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related role required. 3+ years of hands-on experience with Power BI required. Demonstrated experience developing dashboards, reports, and data models required. Experience working with cloud-based data platforms and analytics tools preferred. Experience presenting data insights to leadership and non-technical audiences preferred.

title: Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Contract Type:  Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration:  6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months. About the Role  We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn  to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation. Key Responsibilities  Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact  Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight  Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement  Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance  Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation  Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.  Required Qualifications & Experience  Technical & Operational Expertise  Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous.  Revenue & Churn Acumen  Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable.  Leadership & Stakeholder Management  Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.   Why This Role Matters  Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue. As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

title: Supervisor de Hardware
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Supervisor de Hardware em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Since 1965, Stoneridge has designed and manufactured advanced, award-winning technologies including driveline and transmission actuation systems, vision systems, emissions control systems, safety systems, and security and monitoring systems for vehicle OEMs in the commercial vehicle, automotive, off-highway and agricultural vehicle markets. We’re focused on the areas of greatest market need – both today and tomorrow. Our core products and technologies are aligned with industry megatrends including safety and security, vehicle intelligence, fuel efficiency and emissions. Join the Stoneridge Team as we continue to build upon our strong history and reputation for quality products to deliver innovative products and systems that address a need, exceed our customers’ expectations, and motivate our team.  Responsabilidades   Participar da definição e implementação de soluções tecnológicas, contribuindo com novas ideias e sugestões para novos produtos, novas funcionalidades e atualizações de produtos existentes, em nível de componentes, esquemas elétricos, bem como nos processos e ferramentas de desenvolvimento.  Definir ou participar da definição de conceitos e especificações técnicas de novos produtos e atualizações dos existentes, contribuindo com informações para apoiar a tomada de decisão e análises de viabilidade relacionadas a risco, prazo, custo e qualidade.  Desenvolver hardware para novas implementações ou modificações em produtos existentes, atendendo aos objetivos de prazo, custo e qualidade dos projetos ou atividades.  Pesquisar, sugerir e definir componentes eletrônicos a serem utilizados nos produtos, bem como sugerir e/ou definir arquiteturas e circuitos integrados para os projetos, em conjunto com a equipe de hardware, buscando sempre a solução mais adequada considerando custo, desempenho e tecnologia.  Acompanhar atividades de certificação e testes de produtos, analisar falhas identificadas e sugerir e/ou implementar ações corretivas, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua e redução de falhas e tempo de desenvolvimento.  Monitorar continuamente o mercado de componentes eletrônicos e produtos finais, mantendo-se atualizado sobre novos lançamentos, soluções e tecnologias que possam ser aplicáveis ou representar riscos para o negócio da empresa.    Responsabilidades do Coordenador de Hardware   Gerenciar a estrutura e qualificação da equipe.  Garantir que as tecnologias utilizadas estejam alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos aprovados pela empresa.  Estabelecer metodologias e processos, além de acompanhar e gerenciar as atividades em andamento, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos e a qualidade das entregas.  Participar, quando solicitado, de projetos de inovação tecnológica, lançamentos de novas linhas ou mix de produtos, bem como de atividades de teste, como produção piloto.  Manter-se atualizado por meio da participação em cursos, seminários e outras atividades de desenvolvimento profissional, visando melhoria contínua e acompanhamento das inovações tecnológicas.    Responsabilidades Gerais   Zelar por um ambiente de trabalho positivo, incentivando a participação e contribuição de todos para otimização dos resultados.  Cumprir normas, instruções e procedimentos internos relacionados à qualidade, meio ambiente, requisitos de clientes, saúde e segurança do trabalho, medicina preventiva, entre outros; seguir as diretrizes e participar de treinamentos, visando ações preventivas e boas condições de trabalho.  Seguir as políticas da Stoneridge quanto à conduta, conforme o Código de Conduta e Políticas Globais.  Executar outras atividades profissionais correlatas ao cargo, conforme orientação do superior imediato.    Formação   Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Eletrônica, Mecatrônica, Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.    Experiência   Experiência desejada de 10 anos na função ou em cargo similar, com atuação em:  Desenvolvimento de produtos;  Desenvolvimento de hardware e eletrônica embarcada.         #J-18808-Ljbffr

Key Responsibilities  FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.)  on markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks  across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades  to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics  across EM FX markets.  Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies  to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools  where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization . Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.  Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automated hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers  via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .  Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners  across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs  and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure  supporting global payments and settlement flows.  Requirements  Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience  in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .  Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets  NDF markets and offshore hedging  Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks  Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems  Hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation platforms  Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .  Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments . Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks . Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations . Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources . Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies . Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations . Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Senior Machine Learning Engineer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer  who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations  behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you’re someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you’ll feel at home here. This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion  within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us. What you’ll do  Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models  for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling  to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions  that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences  within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.  What we’re looking for  We’re intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you’re strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we’d love to hear from you. You’ll be successful  in this role if you have : Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms  (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning  (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow).  Nice to have (not required) Experience with NLP and/or LLMs  (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS , such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., SageMaker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval .  Why Join Us  You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You’ll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction. Equal Opportunity  Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Detalhar requisitos de negócio junto aos times de vendas, marketing e serviços, transformando demandas em especificações funcionais claras para o time técnico. Para esta vaga, é essencial:  Experiência prática comprovada em Salesforce Sales Cloud  e Service Cloud  (mínimo 2 anos atuando como key user, analista funcional ou consultor). Conhecimento sólido de processos de vendas , CRM  e atendimento ao cliente  (ex.: ciclo de leads, oportunidades, casos, SLAs). Ambiente escalável de alta demanda (Jobs/Schedules com multi-thread) Banco de Dados: Conhecimento profundo em SQL Server ou Oracle (Queries, Procedures e Tuning). Gestão de Código: Experiência com ferramentas de controle de versão (Git, GitLab ou Azure DevOps). Testes Unitários / TDD: Criar testes de alta complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados. Conhecimento funcional avançado nos módulos principais (SIGAEST, SIGAPCP, SIGAFIS, SIGAFAT, SIGAFIN, SIGAGPE entre outros). Experiência com ferramentas de CI/CD aplicadas ao Protheus. A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados. E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente. Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma. Dito isso, oferecemos: ● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador; ● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais; ● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores; ● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria... ● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito; ● Plano de saúde e odontológico; ● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação; ● Vale transporte; ● Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida; ● Espaço de lactário; ● Bicicletário; ● Vestiário; ● Seguro de vida; ● Auxílio creche; ● Previdência privada; ● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar; ● Gympass. Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc. #Ouseetransforme #sejaTOTVS

A contratação é no modelo CLT , com atuação 100% remota . Principais Responsabilidades:  Atuação Estratégica e Técnica  Atuar como engenheiro(a) sênior, participando diretamente do desenvolvimento (design, codificação e entrega de features). Liderar o desenho e evolução da arquitetura de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, confiabilidade e performance. Trabalhar com tecnologias modernas como Snowflake, Databricks e serviços em cloud (AWS/Azure). Gerenciar e desenvolver o time, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alta performance. Incentivar o crescimento técnico e de carreira dos engenheiros. Atuar em conjunto com Product Managers na descoberta e definição de soluções, garantindo alinhamento com necessidades do negócio. Definir e garantir boas práticas de arquitetura, engenharia e metodologias ágeis. Gerenciar e reduzir dívida técnica da plataforma. Liderar iniciativas de análise, planejamento e execução de projetos de dados. Garantir entregas consistentes e alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos. Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de dados, produto, engenharia e stakeholders de negócio. Gerenciar infraestrutura com práticas modernas (Terraform, Ansible, Azure Application Insights). Requisitos Técnicos (Obrigatórios)  Experiência sólida com pipelines de dados, ETL e ambientes produtivos. Experiência com Airbyte, Fivetran, Snowflake, Databricks e Azure Data Factory. Forte domínio de SQL e modelagem de dados (incluindo grandes volumes). Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Power BI e Sigma. Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible). Programação em Python (diferencial: Scala). Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes. Conhecimento em data lakes, bancos relacionais, NoSQL e OLAP. Boa comunicação e visão orientada a produto. Inglês fluente.  Diferenciais  Experiência com pipelines de AI/ML e serviços como AWS SageMaker ou Azure Synapse. Vivência com governança de dados e qualidade. Background em sistemas distribuídos, APIs ou arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.  Formação e Experiência  Mais de 6 anos de experiência em Data Engineering (hands-on). Mais de 3 anos liderando times ou iniciativas de dados. Formação em Ciência da Computação, Data Science ou áreas correlatas.

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
Empresa está contratando Médico Gastroenterologista em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"  Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!  A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia!  Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos; PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES  Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.  Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.  Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.  Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.  Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.  Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.  REQUISITOS   Formação Acadêmica:   Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).  Certificações:   Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho); ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área; Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);  Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;  Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais. Competências Comportamentais:  Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho:  REMOTO Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo. IMPORTANTE:  MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:  Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.
